children: Liberty Latin America disclosed confidential term sheets and cleansing materials related to potential restructuring of Liberty Puerto Rico debt.
Provided Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2: latest commercial term sheets and confidential information exchanged with Restricted Holders.
Potential Transaction seeks reconsolidation of UnSub into ConsolidatedCo and possible separation of LPR as standalone New LPR with a TSA.
Proposed new-money first-out financing of $410mm to refinance UnSub debt, backstopped by AHG and offered to term loan/bond/RCF lenders.
Takeback debt proposals include ~ $1,250mm second‑out at 8.00% and structural target to limit post‑deal leverage to no more than 4.0x.
Presentation shows LPR projections: 2026E adjusted OIBDA $390mm, unlevered FCF recovering to $103mm in 2026E and higher thereafter.
